name: Shenzhen Xunjiexing Technology Corp. Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Xunjiexing Technology Corp. Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of printed circuit boards (PCB) in China and internationally. The company offers PCB prototypes and mass-produced boards. Its products are used in the automotive electronics, computers and communications, smart consumer devices, smart security, industrial control, medical devices, new energy/photovoltaic energy storage, rail transportation, and other industries. The company exports its products to Japan, South Korea, Europe, and the United States. Shenzhen Xunjiexing Technology Corp.
